name: legal
description: Immigration and legal document automation testing with visa petitions, case filings, evidence compilation, and regulatory compliance

scenarioGenerators.name: visa-petition
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate test scenarios for preparing immigration visa petitions. Include form selection, evidence gathering, eligibility assessment, and filing package assembly for various visa categories.

scenarioGenerators.name: case-analysis
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate scenarios for analyzing legal cases, extracting key facts, identifying applicable precedents, and drafting legal memoranda. Include edge cases with conflicting regulations and ambiguous eligibility.

constraints.name: pii-protection
constraints.description: All generated PII must be flagged as synthetic and never use real SSNs, A-numbers, or passport data

constraints.name: form-accuracy
constraints.description: Form numbers and field names must match current USCIS form versions

constraints.name: regulatory-currency
constraints.description: Regulatory citations must reference valid INA sections and CFR parts
